svg.title: agent-bom end-to-end evidence workflow
svg.desc: Sources flow through collection, normalization, correlation, ownership, remediation, verification, and action.
svg.text: One evidence workflow across every environment
Rank paths with evidence, not raw volume
Fix, accept risk, or mark a false positive
Export, centralize, or enforce at runtime
3 · INVESTIGATE › PATH › IMPACT › OWNER › FIX › VERIFY
Unavailable remains unavailable · partial stays explicit
